recognize_zh: 中央一團細胞中，上方有兩個光滑、均質深紫、不見染色質紋理的圓形核物質，旁邊細胞圍繞且細胞質有空泡，類似 LE 現象中嗜中性球圍繞游離核物質的聚集（rosette）；但解析度有限，典型新月形被擠壓核看不清楚。
features: Cluster of cells in a marrow aspirate smear with surrounding red cells
Two smooth, rounded, homogeneous deep purple masses at the top of the cluster lacking chromatin detail
Adjacent cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and indented nuclei clustered around the masses
A separate mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus at upper right
Limited resolution and focus; classic crescentic displaced nucleus not clearly resolved
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of cells surrounded by red cells. At the top of the cluster are smooth, rounded, homogeneous purple masses without chromatin structure, and the adjacent cells show vacuolated cytoplasm and indented nuclei, an arrangement reminiscent of phagocytes aggregating around free denatured nuclear material. Image resolution and focus are limited, and a classic LE cell with a peripheral crescentic host nucleus is not clearly resolved in this field. Findings are suggestive of LE phenomenon (rosette formation) in the given clinical context of systemic lupus erythematosus, though a cell clump cannot be fully excluded.

ddx.vs: The engulfed nucleus in a tart cell preserves chromatin texture, whereas LE material is smooth and homogeneous.

ddx.dx: Clump of myeloid precursors or megakaryocyte fragment
ddx.vs: Precursor clumps show individual nuclei with chromatin and nucleoli and no homogeneous extracellular nuclear bodies.
Tumor clusters show cohesive, atypical nuclei with nucleoli rather than homogeneous amorphous nuclear masses.
